target.title: fix(voice-call): share webhook replay tracking
target.body:
Supersedes #98712 because the contributor fork predates the current `main` history and cannot be refreshed through GitHub's verified branch-edit path without replaying unrelated repository history.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where mock-provider webhook verification did not supply a stable verified request key, so duplicate deliveries could repeat voice-call side effects.

## Why This Change Was Made

Twilio, Plivo, Telnyx, and Mock now use one bounded replay tracker instead of provider-local cache variants. Verified request identity stays provider-derived while replay lifetime and eviction remain consistent across carriers.

## User Impact

Repeated verified webhook deliveries are acknowledged without processing the same call event twice, including in mock-provider and test deployments.

## Evidence

- Focused local voice-call suite: 71/71 tests passed.
- Blacksmith Testbox focused suite: 71/71 tests passed.
- Real TCP server probe sent the same POST twice: both returned 200 while exactly one event was processed.
- Maintainer rewrite removed 190 lines of duplicate provider-local replay logic while centralizing the bounded 10-minute behavior.
- Fresh Codex autoreview: clean, 0.97 confidence.
- Original contributor credit from #98712 is preserved in the commit.

Known proof gaps: none for the replay/deduplication path.
